summary: This plugin adds a "Web Chat" entry in the DSH sidebar to open chat.deepseek.com, opening it in a dedicated desktop child window when the dsh-desktop bridge is available, and otherwise navigating in the current webview.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The plugin’s user-facing purpose is a UI entrypoint enhancement: it adds a sidebar control in DSH and routes users to chat.deepseek.com, preferring a desktop-child-window flow when the local desktop bridge is available and otherwise using webview navigation. This is a navigation/interaction plugin with a minor local-bridge call and a toggle setting, so it is best classified under navigation-panels with moderate caution around network and local bridge use.
